description: This file defines an abstract class 'BrandedDialogFragment' that extends 'DialogFragment' and implements 'Branded'. It overrides the 'onStart' method to apply branding colors when the dialog fragment starts.

classes.name: BrandedDialogFragment
classes.description: An abstract class for dialog fragments that applies branding colors on start.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Overrides the onStart method to set branding color when the dialog fragment starts.
